title: THE TRUTH
achievementDesc: Break the contract and send Coach 313 home.
lines: *You enter the date. One. Zero. One. Three.
*Every light in Unit 313 comes on at once — not the cold fluorescent white, but a warm, impossible gold.
*The Collector's ledger opens by itself. You read the names out loud, all thirteen, the way Mara asked. Walter Pruitt. Ellis Crane. Adeline Marsh. Lily Marsh...
*With every name, a line in the ledger burns away.
THE COLLECTOR: "That was not in the contract."
MARA: "It was. Clause thirteen. You just never thought anyone would read it."
*He is gone the way a shadow goes when you turn on a light: not leaving, just no longer having been there.
*Out on the lot, a bus pulls up. Coach 313, clean and dry and yellow. Walter is at the wheel. He tips his cap to you.
*Mr. Crane boards first, ticket in hand. A woman with a soft, crooked smile lifts a little girl in a yellow raincoat up the steps. Lily waves at you through the window.
*Mara steps out of the glass — just Mara, in a faded uniform, badge number 0412. She looks at you for a long time.
MARA: "Thank you for reading the rules. And for knowing which ones to break."
*She gets on the bus. It drives toward the reservoir, and the water is not there. There is only road, and the road goes on.
*At 6:00 AM, Unit 313 goes dark for the first time since 1988. It never turns on again.
*Meridian Roadside Services files for bankruptcy that spring. You keep one thing: a wet quarter, dated 1987. It is finally dry.

title: THE ESCAPE
achievementDesc: Refuse the Collector and walk away alone.
lines: THE COLLECTOR: "No?" *He closes the ledger with a soft clap.* "Then you're no use to me. How refreshing."
*He is gone. The lot is empty. For the first time in seven nights, nothing is waiting at the edge of the light.
*At 6:00 AM you take off the Meridian badge, set it on the counter, and walk to your car. Nothing stops you.
*In the rear-view mirror, Unit 313 glows behind you. A small yellow shape stands beside it. Then the road bends, and it is gone.
*You never go back to Kessler Flats. You avoid Route 9. You stop drinking bottled water.
*But some nights, at 3:13 AM exactly, you wake up and taste the reservoir. And you wonder who is working the booth.
*You survived. That was all the job ever asked of you. It was never all it could have been.

title: THE REPLACEMENT
achievementDesc: Sign the ledger and become the machine.
lines: *The ink is still wet when the glass of the machine begins to soften.
THE COLLECTOR: "Every arrangement needs someone to keep it running. You were so good at it."
*It doesn't hurt. That is the worst part. It feels like sitting down after a very long shift.
*From inside, the lot looks smaller. The rows of cans are warm against your back. Your reflection in the glass is wearing a badge, and the number on it is 0.
*Somewhere beside you, Mara's voice, very tired: "I'm sorry. I tried." Then she is quiet, and you understand that she is free, and that you are not.
*The next night a new attendant arrives. They are nervous. They read the handbook.
*At 3:13 AM, you try to warn them. All that comes out is a receipt.
*THANK YOU FOR YOUR SERVICE, NO. 0.

title: THE DEBT
achievementDesc: Refuse the Collector after taking too many of his deals.
lines: *You say no.
*Your hand signs anyway. You watch it do it. It has been his for a while now — since the first can, the first open panel, the first deal.
THE COLLECTOR: "You already said yes. Many times. I wrote each one down."
*Every coin you took from him is in the coin box now, and so are you.
*From inside the glass, the lot looks small. Mara is gone; you can feel the empty place where she used to be.
*The next attendant arrives on a Tuesday. You print them a receipt that says RUN. It comes out reading THANK YOU FOR YOUR SERVICE.

title: THE EMPTY SEAT
achievementDesc: Break the contract without keeping Lily safe.
lines: *You enter the date. One. Zero. One. Three. The lights burn gold, and the ledger opens itself.
*Name by name, the lines burn away. The Collector is gone like a shadow under a lamp.
*Coach 313 pulls up, clean and dry. Walter tips his cap. Mr. Crane boards with his ticket. Mara steps out of the glass and climbs on.
*A woman with a soft, crooked smile is the last to board. She stops on the top step and looks back across the lot, searching.
*There is a small seat by the window with no one in it.
*The bus waits as long as it can. Then the doors close, and it goes.
*Unit 313 goes dark. You stay until noon, watching the treeline for a yellow raincoat. You never see one.

title: THE LAST PASSENGER
achievementDesc: Break the contract while Mr. Crane still doesn't know where he's going.
lines: *The keypad turns gold. The ledger burns. The Collector is gone.
*Coach 313 arrives. Everyone boards — everyone but a man in a brown suit standing at the stop, checking his watch.
MR. CRANE: "Is this the 2:58? No... no, I'm waiting for the 2:58."
*He never knew what year it was. Nobody told him in time. The bus leaves without him.
*The machine is dark now. There's no 3:13 anymore, no minute to come back through. He just stands there.
*You bring him a coffee every morning for the rest of the summer. He thanks you every time, like it's the first time.
*In September, he's gone. The bus stop sign is gone too. You hope, very hard, that a bus finally came.

title: THE DRIVER
achievementDesc: Break the contract before Walter was ready to go.
lines: *The keypad turns gold. The ledger burns. The Collector is gone.
*Coach 313 pulls up to the stop. The doors open. The passengers climb aboard, one by one.
*The driver's seat is empty. Walter never finished his water. He's still down there, waiting to be ready.
*Mara looks at you. Lily looks at you. Everyone looks at you.
*You were the one who kept the booth. You can keep a route too.
*You sit down behind the wheel. It's cold, and wet, and fits you exactly. The road goes toward the reservoir and the water parts.
*Somewhere a long way from Kessler Flats, the bus finally reaches the end of the line. You don't come back. You don't need to.

title: THE NAMELESS
achievementDesc: Enter the date without the passenger manifest.
lines: *You enter the date. The lights go gold — then white — then out.
*The ledger tears itself apart. Pages blow across the lot like leaves, and on every page the names are blank.
*Without their names, the passengers don't know who they are. Thirteen shapes walk out of the reservoir and stand on the lot, looking at their hands.
*They don't get on any bus. There is no bus. They just wander, out along Route 9, into the morning.
*The contract is broken. The Collector is gone. So is everyone, in a way.
*For years afterward, drivers on Route 9 report people walking the shoulder at dawn, asking anyone who stops if they know their name.

title: THE WRONG MINUTE
lines: *You press 0-3-1-3. The keypad flashes purple.
THE COLLECTOR: "Thank you. I did so hope you'd try the time."
*The clock on the machine stops at 3:13. So does the clock on the wall. So does your watch. So does your heart, almost.
*The minute closes around the booth like water closing over a bus.
*It is 3:13 AM. It is always 3:13 AM. Customers come, and come, and come, and none of them ever leave, and neither do you.
*Somewhere outside the minute, it is morning. You will never see it.

title: PAID IN FULL
achievementDesc: Pay the Collector with exact change.
lines: *You push the thirteen coins across the counter. The Collector looks down at them for a very long time.
THE COLLECTOR: "Exact change." *He sounds, for the first time, uncertain.* "One from each of them. They paid your fare."
*He closes the ledger. Your line is gone. So is Mara's.
THE COLLECTOR: "The account is settled. The arrangement continues. Someone else will sit here next week."
*Mara steps out of the glass beside you, blinking in the light, badge number 0412. You walk to your car together. Neither of you looks back.
*Behind you, Unit 313 hums on. The passengers are still there, still coming back at 3:13. You bought two people out. Not thirteen.
*It's something. Some nights it even feels like enough.

title: MARA'S SHIFT
achievementDesc: Sign the ledger to free Mara.
lines: *You sign. But you write a condition under your name, the way Mara taught you to read the fine print: In exchange for the release of M. Quill.
THE COLLECTOR: "...Sentimental. Accepted."
*The glass softens. As you sink into it, someone climbs out the other way — Mara, solid and dry, gasping like a swimmer breaking the surface.
MARA: "No — no, you weren't supposed to —"
*"Go home," you tell her, and your voice comes out as the hum of a compressor.
*She stays until sunrise, her hand flat on the glass over yours. Then she leaves.
*Every night after, at 3:13, someone leaves a cold cola on the counter. You can't drink it. You appreciate it anyway.

title: COMPANY MAN
achievementDesc: Hand Mara's evidence to Hale, then sign.
lines: *You sign. The Collector smiles under his hat — you can't see it, but you hear it.
THE COLLECTOR: "Mr. Hale has been asking for a successor. You've already shown you can be trusted with sensitive materials."
*The machine does not take you. The company does.
*Six months later, you have a gray Meridian windbreaker, a corporate card, a ring with a logo on it, and the healthiest complexion anyone has ever seen.
*You call the new attendant at 313 on their first night. 'Evening,' you say. 'Job's easy. Read the handbook before three.'
*You never get sick. You never have a bad day. And you never, ever drive past the reservoir.

title: TOGETHER
achievementDesc: Refuse the Collector with Lily safe beside you.
lines: THE COLLECTOR: "No? How tedious." *He closes the ledger.* "Keep the booth, then. I'll find another."
*He's gone. At 6:00 AM you take off the badge and walk to your car.
*When you open the door, a small girl in a yellow raincoat climbs into the back seat and buckles herself in. She looks at you like it's obvious.
*The contract isn't broken. The others are still out there. But the Hollow can't follow her past the county line, and you drive for a very long time.
*She never speaks. She never grows. She leaves strawberry gum wrappers everywhere.
*Some nights she stands at your window at 3:13 and looks back toward Kessler Flats. Then she climbs into bed, and you leave the light on.

title: THE ONES WHO LEFT
achievementDesc: Help Walter, Mr. Crane and Lily, then refuse the Collector.
lines: THE COLLECTOR: "No?" *He closes the ledger.* "Then I'll keep what I have. Most of it."
*But some of it is already gone. Walter is ready. Mr. Crane knows the year. Lily is safe.
*At sunrise, a yellow bus pulls up to the stop on its own. Walter is driving. Mr. Crane holds the door for a little girl and a woman with a crooked smile.
*The rest of the passengers aren't on it. They can't be, not while the contract holds. Mara watches from the glass and waves.
*You leave Kessler Flats with your last paycheck and a wet quarter in your pocket.
*It isn't the whole truth. But four people got home who wouldn't have, and you were the reason.

title: OFF THE CLOCK
achievementDesc: Leave the attendant booth during a shift.
lines: *You open the booth door and step out onto the lot.
*The air is wet. The concrete is wet. The edge of the light is much closer than it looked from inside.
*Thirteen people are standing at the edge of it. They've been waiting for someone to come out.
*They're very gentle about it. They take your hands. They walk you toward the water, and they tell you their names, one by one, so you won't be lonely.
*In the morning, Meridian sends a new attendant. The handbook is on the counter, open to Section A.
*A2. Do not leave the attendant booth between 11:00 PM and 6:00 AM for any reason.
